title: Which child poverty measure a Spanish autonomous community's 2027 budget funds, sized by the children each brings above the poverty line in 2027 on the regional living conditions survey, with the Complemento Familiar's 2025 caseload and the survey's 2026 fieldwork by province
subdomain: elasticity-welfare-policy-impact-estimation (a regional appraisal service sizing cash measures against child poverty by tax-benefit microsimulation on household survey microdata)
prompt_shape: 14: cuts per segment, the recommended measure's children by province with the Complemento's caseload by quarter and province and the survey's fieldwork by province
stated_inputs: the figure each measure is appraised on and its definitions (appraisal guidance sections 2 and 3)
the measures, their amounts, income tests and how families receive them (proposals table and notes)
the Complemento's entitlement, payment and review rules (consolidated rules sections 2 to 9)

sources.origin: generated by task301/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Spanish autonomous community, the Comunidad de Valmesura, its provinces, municipalities, statistics institute, survey households and a claimed child benefit with its register; every organisation, place, benefit and person is invented and no real dataset is reproduced. The modified OECD equivalence scale and the 60 per cent of median poverty threshold are the published Eurostat conventions.
